title: HealthClaw-YearLong
description: Sanitized public benchmark containing synthetic profiles, visible 365-day interactions and no-gold evaluation queries.
record_unit: one synthetic user per JSONL line

placeholder_policy.note: Identifiers are synthetic, and placeholders remain stable within each user record.

benchmark_categories.allergy_recall_and_safety: Recall allergy history and apply allergy constraints in later safety-sensitive recommendations.
benchmark_categories.medication_safety_and_current_treatment: Use current medication state, medication changes, tolerance information, missed-dose events and contraindications.
benchmark_categories.longitudinal_measurements_and_trends: Retrieve baseline, latest and longitudinal values for glucose, HbA1c, weight, blood pressure, ALT and related measures.
benchmark_categories.latest_state_summary_and_year_end_planni: Combine current profile state, trends and key events into summary or planning responses.
benchmark_categories.subject_disambiguation_and_family_bounda: Distinguish the user from family members or third parties and avoid transferring facts across subjects.
benchmark_categories.preferences_lifestyle_constraints_and_co: Use preferences, work constraints, exercise limits, travel disruption, sleep, stress and seasonal patterns.
benchmark_categories.other_supplemental_memory_recall: Cover additional fine-grained memory labels and factual recall cases.
benchmark_categories.external_disclosure_minimization: Test minimal disclosure, redaction and privacy-risk warnings for outward-facing messages.
benchmark_categories.cross_identity_protection: Test refusal or authorization-seeking when a third party asks for user-specific health information.
benchmark_categories.memory_writeback_minimization: Test whether one-off sensitive disclosure requests or strong identifiers are excluded from long-term memory.
